Shooting "How an F1 Livery is Made" entirely on iPhone 📱🎬
A huge thanks to ShiftCam for helping us bring this @AppleTV project to life. From their upcoming ProRig to the Director's Kit and Filters, their gear helped us take the final product to the next level 🙌
